finding.finding: Verified: Divulapitiya site S18 equipment is not working, and road R18 is closed. Other reports do not establish current operational asset facts.

S18 has a verified equipment fault (V2-10-OBS-01). Its listed repair action is feasible with an equipment-skilled crew. Road R18 is verified closed (V2-10-OBS-02), but no supplied road connects to S18; the action catalogue provides no alternate access route. Do not infer that S18 is unreachable by every means, so ask the operator about access. No action is held: the evidence does not establish that any action is unsafe or impossible.

questions.question: What safe access route is available to S18 for the equipment repair, given that R18 is closed and no other road to S18 is listed?

finding.finding: S18 (Divulapitiya, V18) is the highest-priority outage: its equipment is confirmed down, and it is the only service assigned critical status and weight 5 by approved policy. The Minuwangoda–Divulapitiya road closure is confirmed, but does not itself establish that a particular repair action is unsafe or impossible. No other service outage is established by the supplied state. The customer complaints and planned Battaramulla interruption do not establish current operational failures; the unconfirmed claim that Divulapitiya is fixed does not override the authoritative outage snapshot. Travel precedes work: departure is 0 and work starts at 25. The 70-minute repair ends at 95, consistent with the recorded end time and arithmetic check. No report establishes a hazard or impossibility for this action, so no defer request is warranted.
